title: XPwithdraw
description: Allows you to withdraw xp and store it in a consumable knowledge book. Can affect or not affect mending based on how you configure it.
body:
**DM ME ON DC [USER-WolfJTA] IF YOU WANT ME TO UPDATE THIS PLUGIN WITH A FEATURE YOU WANT OR TO HAVE ME MAKE A PLUGIN FOR YOU (FREEE)**

Very straightforward plugin. Allows you to do /withdrawxp <levels> to withdraw x levels. config.yml allows you to configure whether xp affect mending armor or not. Uses knowledge book as the consumable, and stacking knowledge books in your inventory can combine (add levels into one book)
